caseName: Double Eagle Lubricants, Inc. v. Texas
caseNameFull: Double Eagle Lubricants, Inc. v. Texas
attorneys: John B. Ogden for appellant., Waggoner Carr, Attorney General of Texas, Hawthorne Phillips, First Assistant Attorney General, T. B. Wright, Executive Assistant Attorney General, and Howard M. Fender, Lonny F. Zwiener and Robert W. Norris, Assistant Attorneys General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Swift & Co., Inc. v. Wickham, 382 U. S. 111, and Pennsylvania Public Utility Comm’n v. Pennsylvania R. Co., 382 U. S. 281.
